_doc: PLACEHOLDER — R28-4 game menu (CLAUDE.md REINTERP AMENDMENTS §4, docs/REINTERP_RESTRUCTURE_R28_2026-07-10.md §4 layer 2). Frame-voice text is functional and near-final by nature (menu labels, the static controls list) — but still Sérgio's to confirm, especially restartConfirmBody's exact wording and whether the pauseGlyphSymbol reads right at a glance (a plain 'II' first pass, cheap to swap for an icon later). S80 adds the look-mode-3 strings: the motion* set (the on-screen button that asks for device orientation — iOS cannot be asked without a real press, so the button is a designed object) and 'recentre' (the menu row that puts forward back where the room's front is). ⚑ S77 adds the unvoicedName* set — THE UNVOICED OPT-OUT for Era 4's deadname beat. It is in the FRAME and never in the fiction (Sérgio, 2026-08-06: 'if it is in the menu setting, then it's okay'; 08_STATUS_REGISTER §8 decision 10), because an opt-out the apparatus grants you is not an opt-out. It never removes the meaning: the subtitle still shows that the system used a name the person does not use. Its companion is the advisory on the pre-fiction panel (data/strings/orientingCard.json's nameNote), which is where a player finds out the setting exists. ⚑ BLOCKED-ON-READER-PASS with the beat itself. All of it frame voice: functional, undecorated, never in the piece's own voice.
title: Menu
unvoicedNameOff: The old name on the record: spoken and shown
unvoicedNameOn: The old name on the record: shown, never spoken
unvoicedNameNote: Later on, a system says a name the person it is speaking to does not use. With this on you still read what the system did — you just do not hear the name.
restartConfirmBody: This wipes everything and returns you to the start. Nothing you do is ever kept, either way.
controlsLines: On a phone or tablet, turn the device to look — the button at the bottom of the screen switches that on.
Pinch with two fingers to zoom the view in or out.
Recentre the view puts forward back where the room's front is.
Fullscreen is available from this menu when the browser supports it.
Esc — or this menu's corner button — pauses.
motionEnableHint: Turn your phone or tablet to look around the room.
motionDenied: Motion access declined. Drag to look.
motionUnavailable: No motion sensor here. Drag to look.
creditsNone: No third-party assets to credit yet.
